card.name: Dates and times in schedules
card.fires_on: The space or first digit right after a day or time in a list of dates, day numbers or clock times, where a second number is about to come. Seen in dosing-day lists, date ranges and office hours.

modes.label: Day-number lists
modes.description: The digit starting the next day number in a list of treatment days.

modes.label: Dates and clock times
modes.description: The space or colon inside a date or an hours-of-operation time, just before the next number.

card.writes: It adds no clear output effect, apart from lowering words about schedules and courses.
card.plain: It fires at the point inside a date, time or list of day numbers where another number comes next.
